title: MJF, Jericho & the Pinnacle
summary: The fight for faction supremacy becomes a battle to keep the Inner Circle—and Jericho’s AEW in-ring career—alive.

chapters.title: The Pinnacle win Blood & Guts
chapters.result: The Inner Circle surrender; MJF still throws Jericho from the cage.
chapters.context: The betrayal escalates after the match has already been decided.

chapters.title: The Inner Circle survive
chapters.result: The Inner Circle defeat the Pinnacle in Stadium Stampede.
chapters.context: Winning allows Jericho’s faction to remain together.

chapters.title: Jericho saves his AEW ring career
chapters.result: Jericho defeats MJF after the match is restarted.
chapters.context: The Final Fight stipulation threatened Jericho’s AEW wrestling career.
